skill.summary: Provides in-depth insights into Jaeger-LeCoultre’s history, craftsmanship, innovations, core strengths, and position in Swiss haute horlogerie.

latestVersion.changelog:
- 首次发布 Jaeger-LeCoultre（积家）品牌深度资料与分析技能
- 覆盖品牌历史、重大创新、核心系列及机芯研发能力
